hero.title: The Legend of Vox Machina — S4 Final Drop (Eps 10–12)
hero.format: Full 12-ep S4 binge-ready Wednesday 6/24 (three-ep weekly rollout completes)
hero.about: A year after the Chroma Conclave, Vox Machina has scattered — chasing love, family, and purpose — until a long-slumbering evil reunites them for one more campaign. Final three episodes drop Wednesday 6/24, completing the season.
hero.why: Tier-3 critic-validated pick: 100% Rotten Tomatoes — fourth straight season of a perfect Tomatometer, which is rare for any long-runner. Drops squarely in your Solar Opposites / Rick and Morty / Foundation lane: adult-animated fantasy, ensemble, witty banter, real world-building, ~30-min episodes. Binge the full season starting Wednesday.
